I am renting this small plot, so I cannot put too much money into it — if the owner asks for it back, my investment is gone. I went to school a little, so I know fertilizer helps the maize, but cash is tight and my husband and I must buy food too. If I can get the FISP coupon this year, I will use the subsidized NPK at planting and urea for top-dressing; without the coupon I will only manage a small amount. I will intercrop with beans like my neighbors do, and I will use the hybrid seed the agro-dealer sells because everyone here says the local seed gives too little.
